scoring_justification: Headline distortion amplitudes and electronic properties are self-reported JSON by the agent; no raw atomic structure data is available for recomputation. Checker compares these reported values to paper-reported gold with tolerances and validates slab layer-heights pattern via structural audit.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold distortion amplitudes for the bulk charge-ordered state: d1=4.24 pm, d2=3.41 pm, d3=2.59 pm, θz=9.08° (from paper main text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's main text numerical values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported by the authors as the computed distortion amplitudes; they serve as the reference gold for the reproduction task.

outputs.description: Distortion mode amplitudes of the bulk charge-ordered state. The checker compares each value to the paper's reported numbers with appropriate tolerances.
Electronic band gap (must exceed 0.1 eV) and total magnetic moment (absolute value must be less than 1 μB) to confirm insulating antiferromagnetic character.

Layer-resolved apical oxygen to oxygen distance (TiO6 octahedron height) for each non-fixed layer in the slab. The checker verifies that consecutive layers show an alternating expanded/contracted pattern (consecutive height difference >2 pm for at least three adjacent pairs in the top six layers).
Electronic band gap (>0.1 eV) and total magnetic moment (|moment| < 1 μB) for the slab, confirming insulating antiferromagnetic nature.

output_contract.notes: The scoring tiers are: reference_match (tolerance-based comparison to hidden paper gold) for bulk distortion amplitudes; threshold_or_better for band gaps and magnetic moments (insulating/AFM criteria); structural_audit for slab layer-height pattern. All process steps are required to reach the scored load-bearing artifact bulk_distortion_modes.json and the other scored outputs.
